Oliver / Emma —

Thanks for the MSA redline. I pulled the doc and did an initial pass — key points below (I'll attach a short summary):

1) Payment terms (Redline Section 4.2): Redwood standard is Net 45 for new enterprise customers. Net 30 is not a deal-breaker but requires approval from Finance and will affect invoice cadence and cashflow forecasting. Laura (Finance ops) is cc'd to confirm whether Net 30 is acceptable under the current onboarding batch.

2) Data residency carve-out (Redline Section 7.3): the requested carve-out for EU patient data is material. We can support a scoped exception if Medilla signs the Private deployment addendum or agrees to a documented transfer mechanism. Please identify the exact jurisdictions and whether the data will be processed in EU-only systems.

3) Indemnity & Limitation (Sections 9-10): your redline increases liability caps beyond Redwood policy. That's likely to require executive signoff. Could you propose a middle-ground (e.g., limited carve for HIPAA-related claims only)?

4) Order Form / Ariba fields: technically we can populate custom fields (remit_to, GL_code, project_code) in the Ariba payload, but standardization is critical. Vivek — can you confirm the max custom field length and whether Ariba SFTP will handle a separate remit_to mapping?

If Medilla can provide the exact paragraph callouts and a short note on why Net 30 / residency carve is required by policy, we can prioritize this with Legal + Finance and fast-track approvals. I’ve attached Redline_Summary_KP_20280305.docx with the high-level asks.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Oliver / team —

Quick technical note following my review of vendor_field_map_medilla.xlsx:

- Ariba payload: We support up to 8 custom PO header fields. Remit_to and GL_code can be added as header fields and will flow to the PO XML as <CustomField_1> / <CustomField_2>. Max length per field is 128 chars.
- PO acknowledgements: Ariba supports ACK windows; we can set default PO_ACK_WINDOW per vendor.
- SFTP ingest: If Medilla prefers a separate remit file for AP mapping, we can accept an SFTP drop and run a nightly reconcile.

Action items for Redwood:
- I will prepare a sample PO XML with the proposed custom headers and share by EOD Wed (attached).
- Laura, please confirm whether Finance can accept Net 30 for Medilla under the current onboarding cohort (cc’d).

Vivek
Senior Product Manager, Integrations | Redwood Inference
